chunks: That was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Humayd ibn al-Ziyad, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Sam'ah, from more than one, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Abdillah, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: In the case of a man who married a woman and did not specify her dowry (mahr), then he consummated the marriage with her, he said: 'She is entitled to the dowry of her peers (mahr al-dufur).'

key_terms.دَخَلَ بِهَا: He consummated the marriage (entered with her)

ai.seo_question: What is the dowry entitlement if a husband does not specify a mahr before consummation?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that if a man marries a woman without stipulating a specific dowry (*mahr*) and subsequently consummates the marriage, she is entitled to *mahr al-dufur* (the dowry of her peers). This ruling underscores the principle that consummation validates the right to a fair compensation based on social status and customary practice, rather than requiring an explicit prior agreement. It reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on protecting women's financial rights in the absence of explicit contractual terms.
